Nippon Chemi-Con.why: Aluminum electrolytic / conductive-polymer capacitor maker whose AI-server sales doubled (JPY 2.0 billion to JPY 4.1 billion, Q1 FY2025 to Q1 FY2026) on data-center demand.
Nippon Chemi-Con.evidence: Net sales of aluminum electrolytic capacitors increased significantly, particularly on increased data center demand (including AI servers) (1Q FY2026 explanatory material, 08-10-2026).

players.product: Large-size aluminum electrolytic, conductive-polymer and hybrid capacitors (KHR series) for AI-server power supplies

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Chemi-Con press release: Financial Results Explanatory Material (1Q FY2026) (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2026 (three months ended June 30, 2026) results: net sales JPY 37,987 million (+23.0% YoY); operating profit JPY 1,673 million (JPY 152 million a year earlier), operating margin 4.4%; profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 867 million. Company: PC and gaming-related sales were hurt by difficulty obtaining memory and other semiconductors, but sales for AI and general-purpose data-center servers were favorable; industrial equipment demand grew on semiconductor and data-center investments; profit rose significantly despite soaring material prices.
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 37,987 million (+23.0%); operating profit JPY 1,673 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Chemi-Con press release: Financial Results Explanatory Material (1Q FY2026) (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: AI-server exposure Q1 FY2026: net sales to the AI servers market JPY 4.1 billion vs JPY 2.0 billion in Q1 FY2025. Aluminum electrolytic capacitor sales JPY 33,558 million (+23.2% YoY), of which conductive polymer JPY 6,456 million (+26.3%). Company: aluminum electrolytic capacitor sales increased significantly, particularly on increased data-center demand (including AI servers); profit rose on higher sales, particularly for AI servers and other high-added-value products, and an improved product mix.
quarterly_data.figure: AI servers sales JPY 4.1 billion (vs JPY 2.0 billion); aluminum electrolytic JPY 33,558 million (+23.2%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Chemi-Con press release: Financial Results Explanatory Material (1Q FY2026) (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company guidance (full-year forecast unchanged; JPY 153/USD): FY2026 net sales JPY 160,000 million (+16.9%), operating profit JPY 8,000 million (+137.4%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 4,000 million; capital investment JPY 5,700 million. Company: forecasting higher sales and profit on increased sales to AI, ICT and industrial equipment markets driven by data-center-related investments.
